terbaru.judul: When Graph Structure Becomes a Liability: A Critical Re-Evaluation of Graph Neural Networks for Bitcoin Fraud Detection under Temporal Distribution Shift
terbaru.pelajaran: The consensus that GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, and EvolveGCN outperform feature-only baselines on the Elliptic Bitcoin Dataset is widely cited but has not been rigorously stress-tested under a leakage-free evaluation protocol.

terbaru.judul: Shared Channel Capacity and Node Lifetime: An Empirical Study of the Lightning Network
terbaru.pelajaran: This study provides a comprehensive empirical analysis of these relationships using a large-scale dataset of LN topology snapshots spanning the period 2019-2023.

terbaru.judul: A Model and Estimation of the Bitcoin Transaction Fee
terbaru.pelajaran: We find that congestion is the main determinant of delay; that the marginal value of priority is priced in fees, which is increasing in the gradient of confirmation time reduction per movement up in the fee queue; and that transactor choice of RBF, CPFP, and block conditions have economically important effects on fees.
We propose a generalization called Temporary PAW (T-PAW) where the adversary withholds a fPoW from pool mining at most $T$-time even when no other block is mined.

terbaru.judul: Is Bitcoin A Hedge Against Central Banking? Evidence from AI-Driven Monetary Policy Expectations
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a weekly Monetary Policy Expectations (MPE) index derived from the Large Language Model (LLM)-based classification of 118,000+ market messages, providing a granular measure of hawkish and dovish monetary policy discourse.
We propose inertial mining, a novel mining protocol that induces that outcome, i.e., a single longest chain in which each miner's asymptotic share of blocks equals its share of computational power.

terbaru.judul: BitSov: A Composable Bitcoin-Native Architecture for Sovereign Internet Infrastructure
terbaru.pelajaran: We present BitSov, an architectural framework for sovereign internet infrastructure that composes existing decentralized technologies (Bitcoin, Lightning Network, decentralized storage, federated messaging, and mesh connectivity) into a unified, eight-layer protocol stack anchored to Bitcoin's base layer.

terbaru.judul: Bitcoin Smart Accounts: Trust-Minimized Native Bitcoin DeFi Infrastructure
terbaru.pelajaran: We present the complete protocol design, including the Bitcoin architecture, the TEE-based arbitration mechanism, and the Smart Account Registry for protocol management.

terbaru.judul: Kardashev scale Quantum Computing for Bitcoin Mining
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper isolates the other component that public discussion often conflates with it: mining.

terbaru.judul: The Evolution of Decentralized Systems: From Gray's Framework to Blockchain and Beyond
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper maps the conceptual lineage from Gray's requestor/server model to modern blockchain architectures, showing how his emphasis on modularity, autonomy, data integrity, and standardized communication anticipated the design of systems like Bitcoin and Ethereum, and, more recently, the Web3 movement and Layer-2 scaling architectures.
